articles.title: LocoMo - Official Teaser Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026 - IGN
articles.summary: Take a look at LocoMo in this trailer for the upcoming cozy city-building life simulator where you don't just build a village, you bring it to life! LocoMo will be available in Early Access on PC (Steam), Mac, and Steam Deck in the second half of 2027, with mobile and console versions planned for later. A demo is coming in the first half of 2027.In LocoMo, build whatever you imagine, from charming little neighborhoods to sprawling worlds filled with thousands of unique villagers living their own lives. Watch as villagers form relationships, pursue their own interests, and bring your creations to life.With intuitive building tools, extensive customization, and expanding modding capabilities, including fully swappable tilesets that could transform your world from a medieval village into a cyberpunk city, LocoMo is all about making the world your own.Create at your own pace, pursue optional challenges, or simply experiment and watch your creations come alive. There's no single right way to play!
